outcome: Maternal outcomes, Fetal outcomes, Labor progress, Delivery outcomes, Complications (obstructed labor, perinatal mortality)
cohort: 94 women in labor with a history of lower segment Caesarean section (LSCS) enrolled over one year.
finding: Partogram monitoring effectively guided timely interventions, reducing complications and optimizing maternal and fetal outcomes in patients with previous LSCS.
mod_finding: The majority of patients (51.06%) underwent repeat LSCS, while 30.85% had normal deliveries, with fetal distress (47.92%) being the primary indication for LSCS.
gest_age: Most deliveries occurred between 37.5 and 40 weeks of gestation
